notes: BUB1B compound heterozygote. c.2210T>G p.Leu737Ter (ClinVar Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic, multiple submitters no conflicts; gnomAD v4 exome 115/1461846) in trans-inferred pairing with c.3006T>G p.Asn1002Lys (absent from ClinVar for this nucleotide change; gnomAD v4 exome 1/1461878). Biallelic BUB1B causes mosaic variegated aneuploidy type 1 (MVA1). Phase not demonstrated: variants are 10911 bp apart, beyond read-pair phasing, and no parental data is released.
